title: A reset is asked for alike for every address
assertion: `/sign-in/forgot-password` sends a known, an unknown, an invited, a not-enrolled (password set, no second factor), a disabled and a locked address to the same "Check your email" with the same status, cookies, words and help text; a code is sent only to an active account with an enrolled second factor (locked included), and the provider's refusals for real accounts are answered as success; the request takes at least its 1,500 ms floor on every path, a thrown one included; it counts in the `sign_in` bucket by the typed address, shared with password attempts, and its refusal reads alike; `password_reset_requested` is recorded for an account and nothing for an unknown address; the address is in no URL, notice, error or log, and the code's masked destination is never shown
noFileReason: Synthetic personas and unregistered synthetic addresses ask for a reset through the local identity provider on an injected clock; no file.
